operatorSeparation.RP: Official wording is Vorstellung ausgewählter Klassen und Einteilungsmöglichkeiten; the assessable classification is an explicit author operationalization, not a claimed identical official operator. The LK Additum also preserves at least two further classes and does not require their synthesis mechanisms.
operatorSeparation.SN: Official wording explicitly applies the chromophore model to structural classification; this is a separate model-based operation. Families named in the remarks are retained as examples; remarks are recommendations under the primary preface, not converted to universally mandatory examples.
operatorSeparation.sourceCountryScope: Both are optional/chosen-context targets. GK Fundamentum in RP has no minimum-two-additional LK Additum requirement; this LK target does not claim full GK-W source coverage.
